overview.text: StableEnrich presents pay-per-request research APIs for people and company enrichment, web search, scraping, places and social/contact data. Listed category prices are $0.015 for enrichment, search, scraping and social data, $0.045 for places and $0.03 for contact information; a generic $0.02 example is not a universal rate. Onboarding is promoted through AgentCash. Its monthly request counter is an operator report, not verified paid demand. Payment-based access does not establish data accuracy, source consent, privacy compliance or upstream licensing.
